description: This PHP class handles Stripe subscription webhook events, processes invoice and refund events, updates investments, and interacts with Stripe API and project models.

classes.name: StripeSubscriptionController
classes.description: Controller class for handling Stripe subscription webhooks, processing invoices and refunds, and updating investments.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes Stripe client and investment repository.

methods.name: subscriptionsWebhook
methods.description: Main webhook handler that processes incoming Stripe webhook events.

methods.name: processRefund
methods.description: Handles refund events, cancels related investments.

methods.name: processInvoice
methods.description: Handles invoice events, creates or updates investments based on invoice data.
